title: גלגל (Gilgal)
author: T. Noy
location_note: Gilgal I and Gilgal III (50 m west), Jordan Valley; no map reference. The body heading is not in the text layer; the item starts with the author line.
notes: Khiamian (Pre-Pottery Neolithic A) village: oval houses, cup-marked stones, charred seeds, a possible cache or foundation deposit of stone tools in house 16.

features.subtype: burial of two children and an adult between houses 10 and 8
features.quote: בין מבנה מס׳ 10 למבנה מס׳ 8

title: ירושלים, ח׳ כעכול (Jerusalem, Kh. Ka'kul)
author: E. Kogan-Zehavi
location_note: Hill slopes of Kh. Ka'kul (Pisgat Ze'ev); no map reference in this report (HA 100 gives 17370-90/13565-95 for the site).
notes: Burial caves and winepress assigned by the excavator to the Late Hellenistic-Early Roman settlement on the hilltop (HA 100 report).
extra_quotes: ליישוב אשר התקיים על פסגת הגבעה בתקופות ההלניסטית המאוחרת והרומית הקדומה

features.subtype: six burial caves (I-V, VIII): forecourt and chamber, standing pit with benches, repositories; cave V with kokhim; cave I with Mamluk sherds
features.period: Late Hellenistic-Early Roman (cave IV clean Early Roman assemblage, 1st c. BCE-1st c. CE)
features.quote: תוארך לתקופה הרומית הקדומה

features.subtype: cave VI: wide opening and a stepped north entrance, levelled floor, no burial remains; perhaps later adapted for dwelling
features.period: Early Roman and Late Byzantine sherds
features.quote: ייתכן כי המערה עברה שינוי בתקופה מאוחרת

features.subtype: cave VII: small oval cave reached by a rock-cut shaft, unfinished
features.quote: נראה כי חציבתה של מערה זו לא

features.subtype: winepress: rock-cut treading floor, settling and collecting vats plastered grey
features.period: sherds Hellenistic to Early Roman (2nd-1st c. BCE)
features.quote: נחשפה במדרון הצפוני של הגבעה וכוללת

title: ירושלים, ח׳ עדסה (Jerusalem, Kh. 'Adasa)
author: H. Khalaileh
notes: Second Temple sherds; Mamluk farm (halls with stone troughs, granary), later dwelling. No feature of the eligible classes.

features.subtype: small cache of complete vessels and a carnelian bead on three flat stones, interpreted by the excavator as offerings of a destroyed pit or shaft burial (no bones)
features.quote: נחשף מחבוא ,קטן שהכיל כלי חרס מתקופת הב״ת

title: פסגת זאב (מזרח א׳) (Pisgat Ze'ev, East A)
author: R. Abu Riya
location_note: Next to the site excavated by J. Seligman (HA 99).

features.subtype: burial cave with three surviving kokhim, one with a covered trough; ash, bones, iron knife blades
features.period: end of the 1st c. BCE-beginning of the 1st c. CE; coin of Valerius Gratus (24 CE)
features.quote: ומטבע אשר נטבע בירושלים בימי הנציב ולריוס גראטוס

title: ירושלים, פסגת זאב ה׳ (Jerusalem, Pisgat Ze'ev E)
author: O. Shorkin
notes: 123 burials; ossuaries inscribed Yehonatan, Aharon, Yehoshua.

features.subtype: nine burial caves with benches, kokhim and arcosolia (three robbed, the rest sealed); one used into the Byzantine period
features.period: 2nd c. BCE to the end of the 1st c. CE
features.quote: תקופת השימוש ברוב המערות נמשכה למן המאה הב׳ לפסה״נ

features.subtype: shaft tomb
features.quote: ומערה אחרת היא קבר פיר מתקופת הב״ק

features.subtype: extensive quarry surfaces in the nari that damaged the tops of the burial caves
features.period: later than the burial caves (not dated)
features.quote: בשכבת סלע הנארי הקשה נתגלו משטחי חציבה

features.subtype: winepress within the quarry (treading floor c. 29 m2, two collecting vats, settling pit), reusing an earlier cistern or winepress
features.period: from the Roman period (plaster type), later reused
features.quote: נראה כי בבניית ,הגת ששימשה החל מן התקופה

title: ירושלים, גבעת המבתר (Jerusalem, Giv'at Ha-Mivtar)
author: R. Abu Riya
notes: Potter's kiln with 1st c. CE pottery and a Year 2 Revolt coin; stone door nearby. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים, רחוב הרמחים ורחוב הסהר (Jerusalem, Ha-Remahim St. and Ha-Sahar St.)
author: R. Abu Riya

features.subtype: slab-covered drainage channel along Ha-Remahim St. draining to Ha-Gai St.
features.period: Mamluk (fill pottery mostly Mamluk, some Ottoman)
features.quote: נחשפה תעלת ניקוז

title: ירושלים, ׳בית אליהו׳ (Jerusalem, Bet Eliyahu)
author: R. Abu Riya
notes: Vaulted hall used as a Mamluk pottery workshop (hydraulic-plastered basin not coded); Ottoman reuse.

features.subtype: drainage channel blocking the south gate of the workshop, with a latrine installation
features.quote: דופן של תעלת ניקוז הנמשכת בציר

features.subtype: plastered cistern by the south wall, probably of an Ottoman building
features.quote: נתגלה בור מים ,מטוייח

title: ירושלים, רחוב השלשלת (Jerusalem, Ha-Shalshelet St.)
author: E. Kogan-Zehavi
location_note: 1992 season at 131615/172285 (printed northing/easting); 1993 season in the Gate of the Chain plaza (17203/13173).
notes: Roman paved street on vaults and a stairway over Wilson's Arch (Early Roman, coin of Pontius Pilate in the fill), Umayyad repairs.

features.subtype: stone-built channel, plastered inside, covered with flat slabs, c. 1 m above the ancient street (1992)
features.quote: התעלה קורתה בלוחות אבן ,שטוחים ותיארוכה לא

features.subtype: built plastered water channel feeding the Tankiziya madrasa and Sabil Suleiman (1993)
features.quote: התעלה הוליכה מים אל מדרסת אל־תנכזיה

features.subtype: channels A, B and C over the Umayyad plaster floor south of the stairway
features.quote: על גבי התעלה נבנתה תעלה B

title: ירושלים, שער המערביים (Jerusalem, Ha-Ma'araviyim Gate)
author: R. Abu Riya
location_note: By the Western Wall, 53 m north of the south-west corner of the Temple Mount.
notes: Western Wall courses with unfinished dressing exposed (Second Temple period).

features.subtype: single oval grave cutting the drainage channel, Muslim burial orientation
features.quote: על ידי קבר בן התקופה ,הממלוכית

features.subtype: slab-covered drainage channel along the Western Wall parallel to the Umayyad street
features.quote: שניקזה ככל ,הנראה את האיזור שמצפון לשטח

title: ירושלים, ׳קשת רובינסון׳ (Jerusalem, Robinson's Arch)
author: R. Reich, Y. Billig
location_note: South-west corner of the Temple Mount; no map reference.
notes: Dismantling of the Umayyad building west of the wall; Herodian collapse of 70 CE on the street. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים, הר הזיתים (Jerusalem, Mt. of Olives)
author: R. Abu Riya
notes: Soot drawings and Arabic inscriptions (name Saliba) on the vestibule ceiling from later use.

features.subtype: burial cave: courtyard with bench, vestibule, chamber with six kokhim; ossuary inscribed 'Yishma'el' with a 1st c. CE glass bottle
features.period: Second Temple period; reused in the Byzantine or later periods
features.quote: נראה כי לפנינו מערת קבורה מתקופת הבית ,השני

title: ירושלים, הר ציון (Jerusalem, Mt. Zion)
author: R. Abu Riya
location_note: North of the road to the St. Peter in Gallicantu hostel.
notes: Hall with two mosaic floors and Herodian frescoes over the pool (public building or wealthy house of the Second Temple period).

features.subtype: rock-cut pool (up to 3.5 m wide, length unknown) bounded by walls 5-7, later used as wall foundations
features.period: fill with a Hasmonean coin (125-76 BCE) and pottery of that time; sealed by the Herodian hall
features.quote: במילוי הבריכה נמצא מטבע מימי ,החשמונאים

title: ח׳ כבר (Kh. Kabbar)
author: Y. Barukh
location_note: c. 150 m north of the ruin, south of Beit Jala.
notes: Building with small rooms; pottery Persian to 1st c. BCE and Second Temple stone vessels; lime kiln damage.
extra_quotes: המכלול הקיראמי מתוארך לפרק הזמן שבין התקופה הפרסית למאה הא׳

features.subtype: white-plastered cistern in a courtyard, mouth covered by a stone slab on stone beams
features.period: site pottery Persian to 1st c. BCE (partial overlap)
features.quote: ובה בור מים מטוייח בטיח .לבן

features.subtype: two cisterns between the outer wall and the excavation area
features.quote: תועדו שני בורות מים וראשי

features.subtype: pits cut in the rock below the floors, function unclear; cisterns and rock-cut installations in the surrounding fields
features.quote: נחצבו גומות שתפקידן אינו

features.subtype: rock-cut shaft tomb with a round domed chamber and a niche; jar, lamp, carnelian beads, one adult female
features.quote: נערכה חפירת הצלה בקבר מתקופת הב״ת
